description: List the raw material feeding a workspace's company brain: uploaded files, plus motions the team closed and shared workspace-wide. Shows what the next nightly run will read and what it has already digested. Link a source from a page's ## Sources section as [filename](?source=<id>).

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: list_wiki_sources
